description: High-value openpyxl operations covering ~95% of real-world Excel automation needs

function.name: openpyxl_load_workbook
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Load Excel file preserving ALL formatting, formulas, charts, and images. USE WHEN: need to preserve formatting, work with charts/images, or modify existing styled files. NOT FOR: bulk data analysis (use pandas_read_excel instead). NOTE: After pandas analysis, save with pandas_to_excel then reload here for formatting. WORKFLOW: pandas_to_excel('temp.xlsx') → load_workbook('temp.xlsx') → apply styles → save('final.xlsx')

read_only.description: Open file in read-only mode (faster for large files)

keep_vba.description: Preserve VBA macros when loading file

function.name: openpyxl_workbook
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Workbook is the container for all other parts of the document.

function.name: openpyxl_get_column_letter
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Convert decimal column position to its ASCII (base 26) form. Because column indices are 1-based, strides are actually pow(26, n) + 26

function.name: openpyxl_column_index_from_string
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Convert ASCII column name (base 26) to decimal with 1-based index Characters represent descending multiples of powers of 26

function.name: openpyxl_coordinate_to_tuple
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Convert an Excel style coordinate to (row, column) tuple

function.name: openpyxl_range_boundaries
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Convert a range string into a tuple of boundaries: (min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row)

function.name: openpyxl_workbook_save
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Save workbook with all formatting, charts, and Excel features intact. USE WHEN: you need professional formatting, charts, conditional formatting, or modifying existing files. NOTE: After saving formatted file, use pandas_read_excel to reload for data analysis.

function.name: openpyxl_workbook_close
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Close workbook file if open. Only affects read-only and write-only modes.

function.description: [OPENPYXL] Create a worksheet (at an optional index).

function.name: openpyxl_workbook_list_sheets

function.name: openpyxl_worksheet_append
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Append a row of values at the bottom of worksheet. USE WHEN: adding formatted rows one at a time, preserving cell styles. SLOW FOR: bulk data insertion with thousands of rows (use pandas_concat or pandas_to_excel for large datasets).

function.name: openpyxl_worksheet_insert_rows
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Insert row or rows before row==idx

function.name: openpyxl_worksheet_delete_rows
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Delete row or rows from worksheet structure. USE WHEN: removing empty rows or adjusting sheet layout. SLOW FOR: filtering data based on conditions (use pandas_query or pandas_drop for data filtering).

function.name: openpyxl_worksheet_insert_cols
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Insert column or columns before col==idx

function.name: openpyxl_worksheet_delete_cols
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Delete column or columns from worksheet structure. USE WHEN: removing empty columns or adjusting sheet layout. SLOW FOR: removing data columns based on criteria (use pandas_drop with axis=1 for data operations).

function.name: openpyxl_worksheet_unmerge_cells

function.name: openpyxl_worksheet_set_visibility
function.description: [OPENPYXL] Set worksheet visibility state. USE WHEN: hiding sheets with intermediate calculations or data. Hidden sheets can still be referenced in formulas.
